theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (R₁ R₂ R : IMRep U n) (F : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (B : ℝ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → AEStronglyMeasurable F μHE[n] → (∀ x, x ∉ K → F x = 0) → (∀ x, ‖F x‖ ≤ B) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], R.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ) • R.orient y) x = R₁.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₁.mult y : ℝ) • R₁.orient y) x + R₂.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₂.mult y : ℝ) • R₂.orient y) x) → ∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (F x) ∂μHE[n] = ∫ x in R₁.carrier, (R₁.mult x : ℝ) * R₁.orient x (F x) ∂μHE[n] + ∫ x in R₂.carrier, (R₂.mult x : ℝ) * R₂.orient x (F x) ∂μHE[n]
